description_en: Queries the top N referers of a website
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-top-referer --biz-region cn --domain example.aliyundoc.com --start-time 1701991920 --end-time 1721561100 --limit 10 --query-type example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainTopReferer

parameters.help_en:
The region of the service. Valid values:
- **cn**: the Chinese mainland.
- **cn-hongkong**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
- **cn**：中国内地。
- **cn-hongkong**：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
> The domain name must have a website traffic forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:

> The value must be on the hour or half hour
parameters.help_zh:

> 必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of data entries to return
